summary: VerifyMe filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-10 reverse stock split effective 12:01 am ET September 29, 2026, alongside a previously declared special cash dividend of $0.15 per share announced September 18, 2026, payable pro-rata to common and Series B convertible preferred holders. Post-split trading continues on Nasdaq under VRME with new CUSIP 92346X305; no fractional shares, with rounding up, and proportionate warrant/equity award adjustments. The dividend is the special-situation element and the reverse split supports listing compliance. Watch record/payment dates, dilution from preferred conversion, and post-split liquidity.
